items.title: Biopharma industry confidence at highest in years despite geopolitical headwinds
items.summary: GlobalData says that the industry has “absorbed significant disruption”, with high M&A levels testament to recovery.

items.title: Voro and Alloy partner on tumour-selective TCE therapeutics
items.summary: Voro Therapeutics and Alloy Therapeutics have formed a strategic research partnership to develop tumour-selective, next-generation masked TCE therapeutics

items.title: Biogen to acquire RayThera for up to $1bn
items.summary: Biogen is to acquire RayThera, a biotechnology company specialising in small-molecule therapies for immunology, for up to $1bn.

items.title: ASCO26: RLTs bring the buzz, but commercial and tolerability qualms remain
items.summary: RLTs were a hot topic at ASCO 2026, but certain limitations must be addressed to facilitate their widespread use in cancer care.

items.title: How biotech executives are confronting the funding and regulatory shifts
items.summary: Amidst regulatory turmoil and a funding resurgence, companies provide insights on how they are navigating the changing industry.
